patterns.prevention:
• **Audit** all coach assignments for upcoming sessions and identify any planned transitions or new coaches starting within the next 30 days—flag these with centre managers before sessions begin.

• **Brief** coaches on engagement and energy expectations before their first session at each centre, including specific examples of what high engagement looks like.

• **Establish** a backup coach protocol so centres are never left without coverage; ensure at least one trained substitute is identified and introduced to each centre.

• **Check in** with centres after their first 2-3 sessions with any new or returning coach to catch satisfaction issues early and course-correct before cancellations happen.
